detail_results.value: Material mid-goal user changes create a Goal Replan Event. The runtime pauses scheduling, computes impact, updates the visible task list, re-steers or cancels child goals, then resumes. Trivial clarifications may apply inline, hard constraints apply immediately, and forks are used only when the new instruction materially conflicts or the user asks for an alternate path.
